certifications.name: SOC 2 Type II
certifications.proof_quote: Daily is SOC 2 Type 2 certified, covering the Security and Confidentiality Trust Service Criteria.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: HIPAA-compliant video chat for customers who have added our Healthcare Add-on. We will sign a BAA.

certifications.name: GDPR
certifications.proof_quote: With GDPR-compliant data policies, we only collect and store data needed to deliver high-quality video calls.

certifications.name: CCPA
certifications.proof_quote: CCPA: COMPLIANT (listed in trust center compliance section)

certifications.name: EU-US Data Privacy Framework
certifications.proof_quote: Daily is certified under the EU-US and Swiss-US Data Privacy Framework Program.

certifications.name: Swiss-US Data Privacy Framework
certifications.proof_quote: Daily is certified under the EU-US and Swiss-US Data Privacy Framework Program.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: Security page states 'Data centers are SOC 1, SOC 2, and ISO 27001 certified' - this refers to Daily's AWS data center infrastructure, not Daily itself holding ISO 27001. No Daily-entity ISO 27001 certificate found.

privacy.ai_training_note: Daily explicitly states 'We never store any audio, video, or screen-sharing data from any call other than through our documented recording APIs.' Pipecat Cloud states 'We don't store your data.' No policy found permitting AI model training on customer call content. Data collected is limited to what is required to deliver service quality.
privacy.data_region: Primarily USA (AWS and Oracle Cloud). EU-US and Swiss-US Data Privacy Framework certification covers international data transfers.

security.name: Encryption in transit
security.value: TLS/HTTPS for signaling; DTLS-SRTP with AES-256 for media (audio, video, screen share)

security.name: End-to-end encryption
security.value: Available for P2P calls. SFU (cloud) calls decrypt and re-encrypt at server in memory only; no persistent storage of unencrypted media.

security.name: Infrastructure
security.value: AWS (global) and Oracle Cloud (USA). 75+ global points of presence. 13ms median first-hop latency.

security.name: Access controls
security.value: Two-factor authentication required for all production access. AWS IAM with role-based access and periodic reviews.

security.name: Penetration testing
security.value: Performed (listed in trust center as a downloadable report resource). Third-party firm and cadence not publicly disclosed.

security.name: Responsible disclosure
security.value: Dedicated Responsible Disclosure Policy at https://www.daily.co/legal/disclosure/. No evidence of HackerOne or Bugcrowd platform; appears self-managed.

security.name: Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery
security.value: BCP and DR plans established and tested. AWS Aurora MySQL with daily backup snapshots. Redundant UPS. 99.99% uptime SLA.

security.name: Cybersecurity insurance
security.value: Maintained (listed in trust center internal security procedures controls)

security.name: Data deletion
security.value: Customer data deleted upon customer departure. Dedicated Data Deletion Policy documented in trust center.

security.name: Subprocessors
security.value: Amazon Web Services (cloud hosting, USA), Oracle Cloud (compute/Kubernetes, USA), Stripe (payments, USA), Sentry (error monitoring, USA)

products.name: Daily Infrastructure (WebRTC API)
products.data_scope: Minimal: IP addresses, developer-supplied user names/IDs if provided, access/error logs. No call media stored unless recording API is explicitly enabled by the developer.
products.notes: Core API product for developers building video/audio experiences. SOC 2 Type II and HIPAA (with Healthcare Add-on and BAA). GDPR-compliant DPA available. Enterprise SLAs.

products.name: Pipecat (open source)
products.data_scope: Self-hosted: data stays entirely within the operator's own environment. Daily processes no data for Pipecat open-source deployments.
products.notes: Vendor-neutral, 100% open source (Apache 2.0 licensed). Published at pipecat-ai/pipecat on GitHub (13,000+ stars). No vendor data processing. W3C WebRTC Working Group contributor.

products.name: Pipecat Cloud
products.data_scope: Session transcriptions stored if recording is enabled. 'We don't store your data' per product page. HIPAA and GDPR compliant.
products.notes: Managed hosting for Pipecat-built agents. Includes multi-region autoscaling, built-in observability, PSTN/SIP telephony, and Krisp noise cancellation. Separate pricing from Daily Infrastructure.

compare.pricing_model: Pay-as-you-go by usage (participant-minutes, recording minutes) for Daily Infrastructure. Separate pricing tiers for Pipecat Cloud. Free tier available.
compare.data_residency: US-primary (AWS, Oracle Cloud). EU-US DPF and Swiss-US DPF certifications cover EU data transfers. No dedicated EU data residency option confirmed publicly.

flags: ISO 27001 claim on security page refers to AWS data centers, not Daily entity itself. Do not surface as Daily's own ISO 27001 cert.
Pipecat Cloud stores session transcriptions if recording is enabled - operators should review this against their own HIPAA/GDPR obligations.
Responsible disclosure policy exists but no third-party bug bounty platform (HackerOne/Bugcrowd) confirmed; program appears self-managed.
E2E encryption for SFU/cloud calls is NOT true end-to-end; media is decrypted server-side in memory. P2P calls are fully E2E encrypted.
